title: Email communication and photo sharing
summary: This topic is mainly about service communication by email, including sending instructions, diagnostic messages, and customer photos, with only a few clearly negative references.

negative.summary: Negative feedback centers on incorrect customer information in emails and email/photo exchanges tied to damage or complaint handling rather than resolution.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mostly document routine email contact, promises to send instructions, or requests for customers to send photos without clear satisfaction or dissatisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are administrative notes about email or photo exchange and do not express clear sentiment.
The topic mixes several communication uses, including diagnostics, instructions, complaints, and photo submission, so a single coherent issue is not fully supported by the examples.
Negative examples are limited, so specific recurring pain points beyond isolated email accuracy and damage-related communication are insufficiently evidenced.
